Name: Haymaker
Description: Haymaker with some members of the Furious Five. Haymaker is a member of an obscure group of villains called the Furious Five alongside teammates Mr. Think, Fumes, Gossip Girl and Badger Teeth. Fumes would run into Spider-Man on Halloween when he tries to escape after a minor heist. One of Fumes' canisters pops in the air and hits Spider-Man in the back of the head. The wall-crawler suffers a concussion as he falls into the alley. A civilian named Rob was dressed as Spider-Man and collapsed nearby in a drunken stupor. Fumes picked up the wrong Spider-Man while Rob's friends take the real Spider-Man back to their apartment.
